module: Node "Push Action Map" (once_instant). Pushes an action map (pushActionMap) to enable its inputs; it is removed automatically when the project stops. Input: name. The todo field points to odd behavior if several projects use the same action map.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

_executionStopped.desc: Removes the pushed action map (popActionMap) and forgets its name.

workOnce.desc: Stores the name and calls pushActionMap(name).
